description: Analyze a navigation tree. Give `tree` as indented text (2 or 4 spaces or tabs, bullets optional, or 'A > B > C' paths) or JSON (nested {label, children} objects, arrays or a key-value map). Optionally `maxDepth` (default 4), `maxBreadth` (default 9) and `pages` (pages or labels that should be reachable, to find orphans). Returns node and leaf counts, depth, nodes and average children per level, the widest branch, items deeper than the limit, branches wider than the limit, one-child branches, naming collisions (siblings with the same name, the same name in different branches, a child repeating its parent), and orphans. Structural checks only; limits are conventions and there is no magic number.

pages.description: Pages or labels that should appear in the tree

tree.description: Indented text, 'A > B' paths, or JSON

name: nav_depth_check
title: Navigation depth
